films.desc_en: A dynamic, vertical social media teaser showcasing the rich pour and vibrant energy of a premium Vranec wine.
films.music: Upbeat electronic lounge, deep bass, rhythmic, 115 bpm
vo_mk: Осети ја вистинската моќ на македонскиот Вранец.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16. Extreme macro shot of deep, dark ruby red wine splashing inside a premium crystal wine glass. High-contrast studio lighting, dark moody background. The liquid is catching sharp specular highlights. Centered composition, rich crimson and obsidian color palette, ultra-photorealistic, 100mm macro lens.
shots.motion: The dark red wine swirls vigorously around the bowl of the glass. Slow push-in camera move towards the swirling liquid.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16. A lone, ancient grapevine heavy with dark purple Vranec clusters, silhouetted against a golden hour sunset in the rolling hills of the Tikveš region. Warm, glowing backlight, shallow depth of field. Centered subject, amber and deep violet color palette, photorealistic, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: A gentle breeze rustles the large green leaves. Slow upward camera tilt revealing the glowing sunset behind the vines.

shots.kf: Vertical 9:16. A towering stack of traditional oak wine barrels in a dimly lit, atmospheric underground cellar. A single shaft of dramatic top-light illuminates the textured wood of the central barrel. Symmetrical vertical composition, warm brown and charcoal color palette, highly detailed, photorealistic, 35mm lens.
shots.motion: Dust motes dance in the bright shaft of light. Slow, smooth camera dolly pulling backward down the barrel aisle.

films.line_mk: Традиција која се преточува во чаша.
films.desc_en: A majestic, cinematic journey through the sun-drenched Tikveš vineyards down to the quiet, resting oak cellars.
films.music: Sweeping orchestral strings, emotional solo cello, 75 bpm
vo_mk: Сонцето на Тиквеш раѓа живот во секое зрно.
Трпеливо чекаме природата да го создаде совршенството.
Вранец. Нашата гордост, нашата вечна винска приказна.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A sweeping, majestic view of the rolling vineyard hills in the Tikveš region at dawn. Golden morning mist hangs low in the valleys between neat rows of vines. Soft, diffused sunrise lighting, epic wide composition, lush green and pale gold palette, photorealistic, 24mm wide lens.
shots.motion: The thick morning mist slowly rolls across the valley floor. Smooth, slow aerial drone camera tracking forward over the vines.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A heavy, perfect cluster of dark, almost black Vranec grapes hanging on the vine, covered in morning dew. Soft sunlight filters through the bright green leaves in the background. Shallow depth of field, rule of thirds composition, rich purple and emerald palette, photorealistic, 85mm lens.
shots.motion: A gentle wind lightly sways the heavy grape cluster and surrounding leaves. Slow macro camera pan from left to right.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Dozens of freshly harvested, plump dark Vranec grapes falling in slow motion into a rustic wooden crate. Dramatic rim lighting highlights the moisture on the grape skins. Dark, earthy background, dynamic central composition, deep violet and rustic wood color palette, photorealistic, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: The dark grapes tumble and settle into the wooden crate. Extremely slow-motion effect, with a subtle camera push-in.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A long, symmetrical row of massive, antique oak wine casks inside a stone-vaulted underground cellar in North Macedonia. Soft, warm amber wall sconces cast gentle shadows across the damp stone floor. Deep perspective composition, sepia and dark shadow palette, photorealistic, 35mm lens.
shots.motion: Soft flickering light dances gently on the damp stone walls. Slow, steady camera glide moving straight forward down the center aisle.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. A smooth, continuous stream of velvety, dark ruby wine cascading into a wide-bottomed crystal glass decanter. The setup is on a heavy oak table in a moody, dimly lit tasting room. High-end studio lighting, elegant off-center composition, crimson and dark brown palette, photorealistic, 100mm lens.
shots.motion: The red wine continuously flows and swirls smoothly at the bottom of the decanter. Slow camera tracking from right to left.

shots.kf: Horizontal 16:9. Two elegant glasses filled with dark red Vranec wine resting on a weathered wooden barrel on a terrace. In the blurred background, the Tikveš vineyards stretch out under a golden afternoon sun. Beautiful rim light on the glass edges, romantic composition, ruby and golden palette, photorealistic, 50mm lens.
shots.motion: Liquid slightly settles inside the two glasses. Slow, graceful camera pull-back revealing more of the breathtaking vineyard landscape behind.
